newsitem.title: THAILAND: TelecomAsia unit to invest in two firms.
newsitem.headline: TelecomAsia unit to invest in two firms.

text.p: TelecomAsia Corp Plc said on Monday its Telecom Holding Co Ltd unit would invest in two new companies with a combined capital of 1.02 billion baht ($32.9 million).

Telecom group TelecomAsia said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that Telecom Holding would hold a 99.99 percent stake in the 20 million baht equity of IS Asia Co Ltd, a computer software company.
It said Telecom Holding will also hold a 99.99 percent interest in the one billion baht capital of Mobile Asia Communications Co Ltd, a wireless telecom firm.
TelecomAsia stood unchanged at 42.75 baht on early Monday afternoon.
